title: Fix the Threshold Filter
statement: The program below is meant to do the following: read an integer n, then a line with n integers, then an integer k (number of queries). For each of the k following lines (each a threshold t), print the elements of the list that are greater than or equal to t, in their original order, space-separated (print an empty line if none qualify). The code below has 3 bugs. Fix them so it passes all test cases.
hints: A mutable default argument like result=[] is created once and reused across every call - that will leak values between queries
Check the loop's starting index against which elements of nums it actually visits
Re-read the comparison the spec asks for: 'greater than or equal to', not strictly greater than
